fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Walkway; Detached Structure; Street Frontage
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Fenced Sections
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the street.
• Keep the rear gate unlocked or equipped with a breakaway latch to allow responders to reach the back of the property without delay.
• Clear any vegetation or stored items along the access drive that could slow or block a responding vehicle.
• Mark or label which access points lead to the rear of the property to help responders navigate quickly on arrival.
• Keep the walkway between the street and the main entrance free of obstructions that could slow foot traffic during an emergency.
• Confirm that the detached structure has a visible address or unit identifier if responders may need to locate it independently.
• Maintain enough cleared space near the detached structure for a responder to work or stage equipment without moving vehicles or other items.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored materials that would block a responding unit from pulling in or turning around.
